status: Source-only native WASI PTY descriptor implementation. Public terminal sessions and full AgentOS PTY parity remain open.

reference.scope: The native master/slave descriptor contract, not the complete terminal API or an interactive shell proof.

baseline.failure: Native guest linking failed because host_process.pty_open was not defined. The expected exited receipt was failed.

abi: existing host_user.isatty and WASI descriptor operations
implementation.storage: Terminal bytes and mode belong to process-local native descriptors. Process source, receipt, queued lifetime and acknowledged parent capture keep their existing R2 owners; there is no second terminal namespace or Worker.
implementation.lifetime: Each duplex endpoint uses the existing pipe pool and open-description reference counts. Dup and child stdio retain the same pair until the final alias closes; child stdout and stderr use one slave output direction.
behavior: Canonical CR/newline processing, byte DEL editing and echo; one committed line per read
Ctrl-D on an empty line yields one zero-byte read while later input stays writable
Raw mode preserves NUL, control bytes, CR, LF and DEL without echo; disabling raw mode restores cooked handling
Cooked slave output expands newline to CRLF; raw output preserves bytes
Native poll reports an EOF record as readable with zero bytes; descriptor rights remain monotonic
Both output pointers validate before PTY allocation; overlapping result slots reject EINVAL
Master drains buffered output before EIO after the last slave closes; ordinary pipes retain EOF/EPIPE semantics
The new pair starts in canonical mode even after a previous process used raw mode, and normal captured stdio stays non-TTY

ptyOnly.scope: Earlier focused run before adding fdstat, poll, invalid-pointer and rights checks; those extra cases passed in the final focused and full gates.

rust.scope: Three direct line/mode/bounds tests plus six existing native Wasmi tests; the workspace Cargo gate passed again in bun run check.

verification.child: A genuine WASI child inherits one slave as fd 0/1/2, observes terminal identity, blocks on canonical input, writes ordered stdout/stderr and exits with code 7. Its parent reads echo and child output from the master and observes the real native wait status.
verification.cancellation: A queued WASI process emits a captured marker and blocks on the empty PTY. Live output confirms running; zero-time wait reports ETIMEDOUT. Explicit cancellation settles ECANCELED and retains the marker without a fabricated exit code.
verification.format: bun run format:check passed; git diff --check passed.
